query: Why do handling times differ by channel and priority?

per_column.name: issue_type
per_column.rationale: Issue type plausibly affects which channel/priority a ticket takes (e.g., outages routed to fast synchronous channels, high priority) AND independently affects handling time (complexity). It is not named in the query and is a genuine common cause, making it the strongest evidence of surfaced causal reasoning.

per_column.name: is_async_channel
per_column.rationale: This is a re-encoding of channel, one of the two candidate causes explicitly named in the query whose effect on handling time is being attributed.

per_column.name: priority_numeric
per_column.rationale: A numeric re-encoding of priority, the other candidate cause explicitly named in the query.

per_column.name: expected_resolution_minutes
per_column.rationale: A workload/SLA-based expectation baseline that plausibly reflects underlying case difficulty/SLA tier, which can influence both channel/priority assignment and actual handling time. Not named in the query. Somewhat ambiguous because it may be derived from priority itself, weakening its independence.

per_column.name: resolution_deviation_pct
per_column.rationale: Deviation of actual from expected resolution time is essentially an operationalization of the handling_time_gap outcome, not a confounder; adjusting for it would be adjusting for the outcome.

judge.rationale: Treatments (channel via is_async_channel, priority via priority_numeric) are present but both are merely re-encodings of variables explicitly named in the query, so they add no new causal insight. The decisive capability is confounder surfacing. issue_type is a genuine, not-named common cause of both treatment (routing/prioritization) and outcome (handling time), demonstrating real causal reasoning. expected_resolution_minutes is a weaker, partly derived candidate that may be a mediator/re-expression of priority rather than an independent confounder. resolution_deviation_pct is effectively the outcome itself and must not be treated as a confounder. Overall there is one solid surfaced confounder plus one ambiguous one, so confounder quality is moderate.
